notes.title: 1.0.1 Minor Patch
notes.content:
Bug fixes:

Fixed camera limits improperly adjusting to resolutions other than 1080p.
Fixed the game not loading at fullscreen on the first run.
Changed the behavior of the selection cursor when using the controller to always stay inside the camera view at any resolution.

Adjustments:

Changed the behavior of the selection cursor when zooming out using the controller to stay in the same position relative to the background instead of being relative to the game camera.

notes.title: Animal Pattern is Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Neblyn's first game Animal Pattern just released! [/b][/h1]

Explore the animal world in this fun, family-friendly game for kids and adults. Sit back and relax and exercise your memory by finding all animal pairs.

The game has full controller support or use your keyboard and mouse to play with simple intuitive controls.

If you feel like playing again, after beating all stages unlock extra modes and randomize the positions of the animals to a bigger challenge, or activate the stop-watch mode and see how fast you beat each level.

Enjoy the experience and keep looking forward to more announcements from Neblyn.
